from re import findall

# login gmail
pw_gmail = next(x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='gmail')
g_token = apis.gmail.login(username='as_moore@gmail.com', password=pw_gmail)['access_token']

invitees_md = apis.file_system.show_file(
    access_token=apis.file_system.login(
        username='as_moore@gmail.com',
        password=next(x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='file_system')
    )['access_token'],
    file_path='~/documents/personal/baby_shower_prep/invitees.md'
)['content']

invitees=[]
for line in invitees_md.splitlines():
    line=line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        name=line[2:].strip()
        if name:
            parts=name.split()
            first=parts[0]
            last=' '.join(parts[1:]) if len(parts)>1 else ''
            invitees.append({'full_name':name,'first_name':first,'last_name':last})

print('Invitees parsed:', invitees)

# inspect drafts 518 and 519
for did in [518,519]:
    d=apis.gmail.show_draft(access_token=g_token, draft_id=did)
    body=d.get('body','')
    subject=d.get('subject','')
    placeholders=sorted(set(findall(r'\{([^{}]+)\}', body)))
    print('Draft',did,'subject=',subject,'placeholders=',placeholders)
    print('Body preview:',body[:120].replace('\n','\\n'))
